name: nixhm-sudo-oci-mail
description: Home Manager system image for oci-mail (Stalwart, SnappyMail, Maddy, Dagu)

disk._comment: HM activation peak revised 2026-05-06: lowered 7→6 after the engine's 3-pass prune (pass 1 dangling, pass 2 unused tagged dangling=false, pass 3 nix-store --gc) consistently leaves oci-mail at 5-6 GB free. /var/lib/docker accounts for 12GB (mail stack: stalwart, maddy, cypht, postgres, snappymail, smtp-proxy, mail-puller, stalwart-sorter — each with persistent layers). Activation typically peaks at ~5GB transient (cp -aR /nix/store + nix-build /tmp) when the latest HM image was already in overlay2 from the prior failed-ship pull. 6GB threshold lets us proceed without manual intervention; first-ever pulls (~10GB peak) still need a 47GB VM with bare-minimum mail data.

public_ports.desc: SMTP (Maddy MX — must be public, RFC)
SMTP proxy (CF Worker ingress — Cloudflare has no WireGuard)
